spec_match.rationale: Contrasts the deprecated-dependent pattern (save in pagehide) with two replacements that work regardless of the change (MessageChannel teardown handshake, eager save).

interactive.rationale: Real typed drafts in three iframes, a fill helper, close-all and reopen controls.

edge_cases.rationale: Handshake has a 1s timeout. The empty-draft, lost-draft and no-ack branches are reported distinctly.

references.rationale: Links chromestatus.com/feature/<id> plus the spec/explainer sections it exercises.

conformance.rationale: Replacement behaviour is not in the suite (it is app-level, not a platform contract). Only moveBefore is.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chromium 153.0.8010.12 (Playwright) at 1280x800 and 360x740 DPR3 touch: all three strategies saved (pagehide still fires), with the handshake ack and eager-save confirmed; no console errors; 0px overflow. The 'A loses its draft' branch requires a flagged build.

telemetry_health.rationale: Asserts explicit and eager saves as the primary contract, and records which pagehide branch ran.

design_system.rationale: CSS variables only; buttons override both background and color; verdict colours use emerald-dark/rose on stone; no raw hex.

accessibility.rationale: Draft inputs labelled inside the frame, iframes titled, results aria-live, focus returns to the reopen button.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Cards stack on mobile with 150px frames, no overflow.

openQuestions.title: Add a fetchLater telemetry arm
openQuestions.detail: Show replacing a subframe unload beacon with fetchLater(). Detect native vs the site telemetry polyfill (which defines fetchLater globally) before claiming native support.

guidanceConsulted.query: iframe lifecycle pagehide visibilitychange unload deprecation
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Send telemetry with fetchLater() instead of unload/pagehide beacons.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Recommended in the migration copy; not executed because the shared telemetry script polyfills fetchLater and a native-vs-polyfill demo would be misleading.

guidanceConsulted.query: form controls radio group fieldset legend accessible
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Group related radios/checkboxes in fieldset+legend and label every control.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Option groups use fieldset/legend or wrapping labels; range inputs have associated label+output.

guidanceConsulted.query: accessible status live region announce async result
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Announce asynchronous results via polite live regions; keep native buttons/labels; visible focus.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Verdicts/outputs are role=status or aria-live=polite; all controls are native buttons/inputs with visible text labels and a 3px focus outline; min 44px targets.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive control panel without horizontal overflow mobile
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use intrinsic grid tracks (minmax(min(100%, Xrem), 1fr)) and wrap long monospace strings so nothing overflows at 360px.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Card grids use minmax(min(100%,…),1fr); outputs use overflow-wrap:anywhere; measured 0px horizontal overflow at 360x740 DPR3.

summary: A practical migration demo whose replacement patterns are verifiably working today.
